# Speech samples

- `jfk.ogg`: 11 s of John F. Kennedy's inaugural address (20 January 1961),
  "…ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your
  country." A work of the United States government, in the public domain.
  Taken from whisper.cpp's `samples/jfk.wav` (v1.9.5) and re-encoded as Opus
  32 kb/s mono.

The owner records the language samples the Phase 5 plan asks for (P5-T11,
T14): `en.m4a`, `hi.m4a` and `hinglish.m4a`, 20–60 s each, with what is said
in `en.txt`, `hi.txt` and `hinglish.txt`. Tests that need them skip, naming
the file, until they are here.
